yaml-preview-enhanced.previewMode.markdo: How previews are opened. **Single Preview** reuses one panel for every YAML file; **Multiple Previews** opens a panel per file; **Previews Only** opens `*.yaml`/`*.yml` files directly as previews (custom editor).
One shared preview panel that follows the active editor.
One preview panel per YAML file.
YAML files open as a preview (custom editor) instead of a text editor.
yaml-preview-enhanced.scrollSync.markdow: Keep the editor and the preview scrolled to the same place. Clicking a node in the preview also reveals its source line.
yaml-preview-enhanced.liveUpdate.markdow: Refresh the preview while you type. When off, the preview refreshes when you save the file.
yaml-preview-enhanced.liveUpdateDebounce: Delay (ms) between the last keystroke and a live preview refresh.
yaml-preview-enhanced.automaticallyShowP: Automatically open a preview to the side when a YAML file is opened in the editor.
yaml-preview-enhanced.disableAutoPreview: URI schemes for which a preview is never opened automatically.
Glob patterns (matched against the file path) for which a preview is never opened automatically, e.g. `**/charts/**`.
yaml-preview-enhanced.yamlFileExtensions: File extensions treated as YAML (used by **Previews Only** mode and the custom editor).
yaml-preview-enhanced.maxFileSize.markdo: Largest file (bytes) that will be rendered. Larger files show a notice instead, to keep VS Code responsive. `0` disables the limit.
yaml-preview-enhanced.previewColorScheme: Where the preview takes its light/dark colours from.
Light or dark depending on the operating system setting.
Light or dark depending on the current VS Code colour theme.
yaml-preview-enhanced.defaultView.markdo: View shown when a preview opens. You can switch views at any time from the toolbar.
Collapsible tree with types, anchors, comments and tables.
Reads the file as a document: titles become headings, `metadata` collapses, text is rendered as Markdown and diagrams appear inline.
The document converted to JSON (anchors and merge keys resolved).
Round-tripped YAML with anchors, aliases and merge keys expanded.
yaml-preview-enhanced.defaultExpandDepth: How many levels of the tree are expanded when a preview opens. `0` collapses everything, `99` expands everything.
yaml-preview-enhanced.showComments.markd: Show YAML comments next to the nodes they annotate.
yaml-preview-enhanced.showLineNumbers.ma: Show source line numbers in the tree gutter.
yaml-preview-enhanced.showTypeBadges.mar: Show a small type badge (`str`, `int`, `bool`, …) after every scalar.
yaml-preview-enhanced.autoTables.markdow: Render sequences of similar mappings (lists of records) as tables.
yaml-preview-enhanced.sortKeys.markdownD: Sort mapping keys in the preview (display only — your file is never modified).
yaml-preview-enhanced.maskKeys.markdownD: Regular expressions (case-insensitive). Values of keys matching any of them are masked in the preview and exports, e.g. `["password", "secret", "token"]` — handy when sharing your screen.
yaml-preview-enhanced.enablePreviewZenMo: Allow pressing `Z` in the preview to hide the toolbar and outline.
yaml-preview-enhanced.enablePreviewConte: Show the custom right-click menu in the preview (copy path/value, reveal in editor, export, …).
yaml-preview-enhanced.useVSCodeThemeForC: Style the preview context menu with the VS Code colour theme instead of the preview theme.
yaml-preview-enhanced.renderMarkdownInSt: Render Markdown inside multi-line string values.
yaml-preview-enhanced.markdownKeys.markd: Keys whose multi-line values are rendered as Markdown when `renderMarkdownInStrings` is `byKey`.
yaml-preview-enhanced.breakOnSingleNewLi: In rendered Markdown, a single newline becomes a line break. Leave off for hard-wrapped block scalars (`|`), so that prose reflows to the page width.
In rendered Markdown, enable smart quotes and typographic replacements.
yaml-preview-enhanced.enableLinkify.mark: Turn URLs inside string values into clickable links.
yaml-preview-enhanced.protocolsWhiteList: Comma-separated list of URL protocols that may be opened from the preview.
yaml-preview-enhanced.imagePreview.markd: Show thumbnails for string values that point to images.
Only images from your workspace (relative paths).
Also load remote `https://` images (this makes network requests when a file is previewed).
yaml-preview-enhanced.enableImageLightbo: Click an image thumbnail to enlarge it.
**Document view:** keys whose value becomes the heading of a block (first match wins).
yaml-preview-enhanced.documentMetadataKe: **Document view:** keys shown as a collapsed `<Kind> metadata` section. `<Kind>` comes from a sibling `type`/`kind` key, e.g. `type: requirement` gives “Requirement metadata”.
yaml-preview-enhanced.documentTextKeys.m: **Document view:** keys whose string value is body text — rendered as Markdown, without a label.
yaml-preview-enhanced.documentFlattenKey: **Document view:** keys that only contain other blocks. Their children are shown directly, without a heading for the key itself.
yaml-preview-enhanced.plantumlEnabled.ma: Render inline PlantUML diagrams. A diagram is a `@startuml … @enduml` block (or any `@start<kind>`) inside a string value, a ```` ```plantuml ```` fence inside Markdown text, or the value of a key listed in `plantumlKeys`.
yaml-preview-enhanced.plantumlJarPath.ma: Path to `plantuml.jar`. Diagrams are rendered locally with `java -jar` — nothing is sent over the network. Run **YAML Preview Enhanced: Test PlantUML Setup** to check it.
yaml-preview-enhanced.javaPath.markdownD: Java executable used to run PlantUML (`java` is looked up on the `PATH`).
yaml-preview-enhanced.plantumlSecurityPr: PlantUML’s `PLANTUML_SECURITY_PROFILE`. **SANDBOX** (default) forbids diagrams from reading local files or using the network, which matters because a YAML file you open may be untrusted. The bundled standard library (`!include <C4/…>`) still works. Use `LEGACY` or `UNSECURE` only if your diagrams `!include` your own files.
No file or network access from a diagram.
Maximum time (ms) a single diagram may take before it is stopped.
yaml-preview-enhanced.plantumlKeys.markd: Keys whose string value *is* PlantUML source, even without `@startuml` (it is added for you).
yaml-preview-enhanced.yamlVersion.markdo: YAML version used for parsing. `1.1` treats `yes`/`no`/`on`/`off` as booleans and understands timestamps and sexagesimal numbers.
yaml-preview-enhanced.maxAliasCount.mark: Maximum number of alias dereferences while resolving a document (guards against "billion laughs" expansion). `-1` disables the limit.
yaml-preview-enhanced.uniqueKeys.markdow: Report duplicate mapping keys as errors.
yaml-preview-enhanced.ignoreUnknownTagWa: Do not warn about custom tags such as `!Ref`, `!Sub` or `!vault` (CloudFormation, Ansible, …).
yaml-preview-enhanced.schema.markdownDes: Path to a JSON Schema (`.json`, `.yaml`, `.yml`) applied to every previewed file. A `# yaml-language-server: $schema=…` comment inside the file takes precedence.
yaml-preview-enhanced.schemas.markdownDe: Map of schema path → glob pattern(s), e.g. `{ "schemas/ci.json": ".github/workflows/*.yml" }`. Relative schema paths resolve against the workspace folder.
yaml-preview-enhanced.allowRemoteSchemas: Allow downloading `http(s)://` schemas referenced from a file or the settings. Disabled by default so that previewing a file never makes a network request on its own.
yaml-preview-enhanced.publishDiagnostics: Also list YAML syntax errors and schema violations in the Problems panel.
yaml-preview-enhanced.printBackground.ma: Include background colours when exporting to PDF.
Colour scheme of exported HTML/PDF/image files.
yaml-preview-enhanced.chromePath.markdow: Path to a Chrome / Chromium / Edge executable used for PDF and image export. Detected automatically when empty.
yaml-preview-enhanced.chromeArgs.markdow: Extra command-line arguments passed to Chrome during export, e.g. `["--no-sandbox"]`.
yaml-preview-enhanced.configPath.markdow: Directory holding the global `style.css`, `config.js`, `parser.js` and `head.html`. Defaults to `~/.local/state/yaml-preview-enhanced` (`%USERPROFILE%\.yaml-preview-enhanced` on Windows).
yaml-preview-enhanced.enableScriptExecut: Allow **workspace-level** `config.js` and `parser.js` to run. They execute code, so they only run in trusted workspaces *and* when this is enabled. Global scripts always run.
description: Preview YAML as a live, searchable tree with anchors, tables, JSON Schema validation, themes and export — the Markdown Preview Enhanced experience for .yaml files.
